quotes.quote: The Number Five, Geburah, in the suit of Earth, shows the disruption of the Elements,
This is emphasized by the rule of Mercury in Taurus

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley on five disks in an inverted pentagram and on the effect of an earthquake (pdf p231).

quotes.quote: The symbol represents five disks in the form of the inverted Pentagram, instability in the very foundations of Matter.
The effect is that of an earthquake.
